A '''''Nu''-class attack shuttle''' was used by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] delegation headed by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Kharrus/Legends|Kharrus]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. While Kharrus's team was attempting to [[Mission to Florrum/Legends|deliver]] a ransom to [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] in exchange for [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Barb Mentir/Legends|Barb Mentir]] shot down the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] over Florrum.
